newsitem.title: GREECE: Selonda-Riopesca Group sees record fry output.
newsitem.headline: Selonda-Riopesca Group sees record fry output.

text.p: Riopesca Group expects record fry production in 1997 following its recent acquisition of a 40 percent stake in Italy's Marina & Maricolture Alto Adriatico based in Trieste.
Management sees total output from the group's three hatcheries exceeding 56 million fry this year, setting a record.
"Selonda subsidiary Riopesca becomes the largest hatchery in the Mediterranean following the recent buyout of Triton Fisheries in western Greece," the company said on Tuesday.

Riopesca acquired a majority 80 percent stake in Triton in January for 280 million drachmas. It will serve as an important hub in the Patras-Trieste route towards central European markets like Germany and Austria.
Riopesca forecast profit growth of 50 percent this year as pretax earnings are expected to hit 1.2 billion drachmas from 800 million in 1996.
Selonda expects pretax profits of 1.6 billion drachmas this year, it said.
Triton Fisheries will benefit from Riopesca's know-how in fry production and a new facility subsidised by 279 million drachmas by the EU will see completion this year.
The Italian hatchery, supplied by the warm water of the Enel hydroelectric power plant will manage early production of large quantities of fry during January to April, Selonda said.

"This translates to a comparative advantage for the group as it allows it to spread sales comfortably throughout the year. Clients who place orders and wish delivery of fry during the early months of the year may be serviced in a flexible manner," it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
